direction: Extend Branchwork Atlas into a fixed-shell mechanical scene deck on About and a data-backed search rail on Work. Same-page About navigation becomes discrete cut/feed/lock card replacement instead of page scrolling; search adds live linked suggestions and a dedicated return page.

references.name: UI Build Reference — Master Index v2

direct_brief: clicked same-page link becomes the physical transition seam
70ms cut then mechanical upward/downward card feed
direction follows section order and browser history
normal anchors remain the no-JS fallback
Work search provides live linked suggestions and a small Enter-driven results page
deliberate_departures: About body becomes a five-scene aperture rather than a long scroll when enhanced
scene body content reveals after physical card movement begins
Work search indexes Work records plus case-study/skills documents and curated contact terms
Reference is a tiny modal rather than another content section
provenance.repeat_reason: This is a behavioral extension of the existing Branchwork Atlas / Signal Thread identity, not a replacement theme.
